description: Image Description: The image shows a close-up view of two intersecting street signs mounted on a metal pole. The signs are rectangular with rounded edges and have a white background with black text. The sign on the left reads "Auerstraße" with a smaller inscription below it stating "3–47," indicating a range of house numbers. The sign on the right reads "Voidschweg." Both signs are affixed to a dark gray, metallic bracket that connects them to the pole.
